Visualise time-series gap-filling from sus_climate_fill_inmet()

Source: R/sus_climate_plot_fill.R
sus_climate_plot_fill.Rd

Unified visualisation for gap-filling outputs of the climasus4r pipeline. Automatically detects production mode (filled tibble) vs evaluation mode (list with data and metrics components) and renders appropriate interactive (plotly) or static (ggplot2) plots plus DT metric tables.

Production mode displays:

  • Time-series of observed (with gaps) vs imputed series.

  • Imputed segments as distinct markers. Consecutive imputed blocks are connected by a dotted line; isolated single points appear as dots only.

  • Interactive range-slider with zoom presets (plotly only).

Evaluation mode displays a 2×2 diagnostic dashboard:

  • Observed vs Predicted scatter with 1:1 reference line.

  • Residual distribution histogram.

  • Residuals over time (temporal-autocorrelation diagnostic).

  • Residuals vs observed (heteroscedasticity diagnostic).

Use it after sus_climate_fill_inmet(), with either the filled data (production mode) or the evaluation list (run_evaluation = TRUE). All of ggplot2, ggsci, DT, patchwork and htmltools must be installed (plus plotly if interactive = TRUE).

Usage

sus_climate_plot_fill(
  df_filled,
  df_original = NULL,
  target_var,
  interactive = FALSE,
  output_type = c("plot", "table", "metrics", "all"),
  save_plot = NULL,
  lang = c("en", "pt", "es"),
  color_palette = c("npg", "aaas", "nejm", "lancet", "jama", "bmj", "jco", "frontiers",
    "gsea", "uchicago", "primer", "atlassian", "observable", "d3", "igv", "cosmic",
    "locuszoom", "ucscgb", "startrek", "tron", "futurama", "rickandmorty", "simpsons",
    "flatui", "bs5", "material", "tw3"),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

df_filled

Output of sus_climate_fill_inmet(). In production mode this is a climasus_df (stage "climate", type "filled"); in evaluation mode it is the named list returned by sus_climate_fill_inmet(run_evaluation = TRUE). The mode is detected automatically from the first target_var.

df_original

A climasus_df of the raw data before gap filling (stage "climate", type "inmet"), e.g. from sus_climate_inmet(). Required in production mode (errors if NULL or of another type); ignored in evaluation mode.

target_var

Character vector (required) of variable(s) to visualise, e.g. "tair_dry_bulb_c" or c("tair_dry_bulb_c", "rh_mean_porc"). In evaluation mode the names must be elements of the evaluation list. With several variables the plots are stacked in one combined figure.

interactive

Logical scalar. TRUE returns plotly; FALSE (default) returns ggplot2.

output_type

Single character string, what to return: "plot" (default), "table", "metrics", or "all" (named list).

save_plot

Single character string or NULL (default, do not save). File path to save the plot: ".html" when interactive = TRUE (needs htmlwidgets), an image path such as ".png" when interactive = FALSE (12 x 5 inches, 150 dpi).

lang

Single character string: "en" (default), "pt", or "es" (message and label language).

color_palette

Single character string, name of a ggsci palette (without pal_). One of "npg" (default), "aaas", "nejm", "lancet", "jama", "bmj", "jco", "frontiers", "gsea", "uchicago", "primer", "atlassian", "observable", "d3", "igv", "cosmic", "locuszoom", "ucscgb", "startrek", "tron", "futurama", "rickandmorty", "simpsons", "flatui", "bs5", "material", "tw3".

verbose

Logical scalar. Print diagnostic information (default FALSE).

Value

Returned invisibly. Depending on output_type: the plot (ggplot or plotly), the DT table (DT::datatable), the metrics tibble (per-station evaluation metrics, or imputation summary in production mode), or, for "all", a named list with plot, table, metrics and data.

See also

sus_climate_fill_inmet(), sus_climate_inmet(), sus_climate_plot_aggregate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
raw    <- sus_climate_inmet(years = 2023, uf = "SP")
filled <- sus_climate_fill_inmet(raw, target_var = "tair_dry_bulb_c")

# Production mode: observed vs imputed
sus_climate_plot_fill(filled, df_original = raw,
                      target_var = "tair_dry_bulb_c", interactive = FALSE)

# Evaluation mode: diagnostics of artificial gaps
ev <- sus_climate_fill_inmet(raw, target_var = "tair_dry_bulb_c",
                             run_evaluation = TRUE)
res <- sus_climate_plot_fill(ev, target_var = "tair_dry_bulb_c",
                             output_type = "all")
res$metrics
} # }
